hero.headline: Beautifully, *unmistakably* you.
hero.text: We create hair and makeup for brides in Leicester, Leicestershire and across the UK. Tell us how you want to feel on the day, and we will take care of the rest.
hero.imageAlt: Bride on her wedding morning with soft, polished makeup and styled hair
hero.detailImageAlt: Close detail of a bridal hairstyle with a pearl hair pin

statement.text: We believe a bride should look in the mirror and see *herself*: calmer, brighter and ready for the day ahead.

aboutIntro.heading: A calm pair of hands for the *morning that matters*
aboutIntro.text:
We keep things personal. From your first message to the last pin in place, we want you to feel looked after and never rushed.

We care about the small things that make a bride feel like herself: skin that still looks like skin, hair that holds through the speeches and a finish that photographs beautifully.
aboutIntro.imageAlt: Nam, bridal hair and makeup artist, at work

servicesIntro.heading: Hair and makeup, for the day and the days *around it*
servicesIntro.text: Every booking is quoted individually, so you only pay for the time and services you actually need.

instagram.heading: Fresh from *our feed*
instagram.text: A hand-picked selection of recent looks and reels from @beautybynamm. Swipe through them here, then follow along for the latest posts, stories and behind-the-scenes.

closingCta.heading: Tell us about *your day*
closingCta.text: Share your date, your venue and a little about the look you have in mind. We will reply personally, usually with a few questions and a tailored quote.
closingCta.imageAlt: Soft morning light on a bridal dressing table
